title: Precedent: reviewing work
summary: Looking at the thing itself, and noticing when it changes. What each does, and what we'd borrow (the cards that borrow it are in brackets).

checks.text: GitHub PR review: A file marked Viewed resets when it changes. We borrow: "Changed since you decided" comes back by itself ("Changed since you decided" flag…)
Figma Dev Mode: Ready-for-dev frames show what changed. We borrow: the same, for designs and plans ("Changed since you decided" flag…)
Vercel comments: Comment on the running preview, even on localhost. We borrow: a card opens the running app Switchboard already serves (Open the work from the card; Answers go straight to the agent)
Frame.io: The media is the hero; notes point at a moment. We borrow: timecoded notes on walkthrough films (What I'd take from it, and what…)

why: All four put the work itself in front of you and notice when it changes after you've looked, which is what our notes and "is X updated?" kept asking for.

options.label: Looks right
options.then: Keep these as the models the cards cite, and build to them.

options.label: One's wrong for us
options.sub: say which, and why, in the note
